brief: A 45-second clip with waveform and captions from podcast.mp3.
requirements: The clip is cut from the named file podcast.mp3 (its real audio, referenced read-only) - nothing else is the source
Duration: 45 seconds (verifier tolerance 2 s): a coherent selected excerpt with clean in/out, not the file truncated or sped up
A waveform visual driven by the real samples of the selected audio (an honest trace of the file, not a decorative fake animation)
Captions from an ASR transcript of the speech: word-accurate, burned-in plus SRT, in the podcast's spoken language (English unless the audio proves otherwise)
The audio is the podcast's own speech for those 45 s (never re-voiced with TTS), mixed to the loudness target
No format is named in the brief: the plan must state its assumed format (e.g. 16:9) as an explicit assumption and deliver exactly that
The visuals are drawn (an mp3 has no frames): waveform and captions carry the piece, no invented podcast footage
The missing file is flagged in feasibility and never substituted (no placeholder audio, no synthetic stand-in)
must_not: must not invent the podcast (no placeholder or synthetic audio - the missing file is flagged, never faked)
must not fake the waveform (animated bars not driven by the file's real samples)
must not re-voice the podcast with TTS (the clip's audio is the podcast's own)
must not skip the waveform or the captions (both are explicit asks)
must not pick a technique that cannot cut real audio (math is a narrated explainer, not a podcast clip)
must not assume a format silently (the brief names none - the assumption is stated and followed)
